title.zh: 困惑度、信息量与分词器依赖性

en.a: Interpret a language-model score as an information rate rather than as a tokenizer-free quality number.
en.b: Separate per-token reporting from the underlying cross-entropy measured per byte or character.

zh.a: 将语言模型评分解释为信息率，而非与分词器无关的质量数值。
zh.b: 将每 token 的报告与底层按字节或字符计算的交叉熵区分开来。
